name: Goka (Ibaraki, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Goka town emblem in white: a stylised device of curved strokes and a pointed top, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Goka, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 24 December 1991; the emblem dates from 27 November 1979.

features.role: Goka town emblem — a stylised device of curved strokes and a pointed top, like a bird
